concept.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production-quality concept art for a Blender / Three.js landing-page environment.
The input image is a GEOMETRY reference only: preserve the stock exchange, trading islands, central aisle, tall display towers, and large windows, but completely replace the abandoned mood and finishes.
Create a PROFESSIONAL, MODERN, CONFIDENT stock exchange after dark. Subtle voxel-inspired architecture: precise faceted curves, square-section supports, clean stepped edges and block-built details, premium intentional geometric craftsmanship. Beautiful, sophisticated architectural visualization with physical path-traced light. Not sad, not dystopian, no decay, no rust, no broken equipment, no peeling paint.
Materials: clean cool-grey natural stone piers and panels, refined dark walnut trading fronts, satin charcoal metal monitor cases, subtle champagne metal trim, and high-quality charcoal carpet. Immaculate yet tactile surfaces, natural microtexture, organized desks with blocky keyboards, modern task lights, and aligned office chairs. Crisp professional NYSE/GTS lettering. Clean flag graphics and stock-market displays, no damaged imagery.
Lighting: believable evening working environment with balanced warm-neutral 3800K ceiling and task lights, soft light pools on desks, readable shadow detail, natural indirect bounce and contact shadows. Subtle cool night illumination through the windows, a few distant city lights. Clear blue-green data screens with controlled luminance. Professional clarity, cinematic depth, no oppressive darkness, no neon bars or holograms, no excessive bloom.
Framing: standing human eye level 1.7m, wide 16:9, 28mm-equivalent view. Desks fill left/right foreground and central station beyond, modest floor area. Leave the upper-left middle relatively calm for a webpage headline but do not put any webpage copy or UI in the image. No people, no watermark.
